subject_entity.notes: General epistle associated with James and notable for its moral exhortation.

object_entity.notes: Leading Jerusalem figure in the apostolic period.

evidence.notes: Traditional attribution; Jas 1:1 self-identifies as 'James, servant of God and of the Lord.'

passage.excerpt: Paraphrase: We learned the plan of salvation from those through whom the Gospel came to us. Matthew issued a written Gospel among the Hebrews while Peter and Paul were preaching at Rome. Mark, the disciple and interpreter of Peter, handed down what Peter had preached. Luke, Paul's companion, recorded his Gospel. Afterwards John, who leaned on the Lord's breast, published his Gospel during his residence at Ephesus.
